description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' for Android applications, providing methods for string escaping, integer parsing, and displaying toast messages.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string manipulation, parsing, and UI notifications in an Android app.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe shell usage; wraps the string in quotes if necessary, escaping single quotes.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses a string into a base-10 integer, returning a default value if parsing fails.

methods.name: parseIntWithBase
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer of the specified base, returning a default value if parsing fails.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Displays a toast message on the main thread context.
